resources.string: Things you blow on: dandelions, bushes, Toads and the blow-powered lifts. Microphone: blow on the phone\'s microphone (asks for the permission; speech and noise are filtered out). Button: an on-screen blow button.
Raise it if blowing does nothing; lower it if the game reacts to noise.
No microphone permission: blowing stays off. Use \"Button\" or allow the microphone in Android\'s settings.
